rows.title: The germinal products overview's Commodity details task is complete once every chosen species has a valid number of packages
rows.detail: The task status on the overview tells a trader what is left to do. Germinal products are counted by packages rather than by head of animal, so on the germinal products set the Commodity details task is complete once every chosen species has a valid number of packages, the one count the page makes mandatory, and every optional answer entered on the page, such as a total gross weight, is valid. The total gross weight and the temperature are optional, so leaving either blank does not hold the task back. With no species chosen the task is not complete. The live animals set keeps its own rule, counting the number of animals.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows the Complete tag when every chosen species has a whole number of packages from 1 to 1,000, with total gross weight and temperature left blank. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-024, -p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-022; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; c-232, c-234, c-462)

On a germinal products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows the Complete tag when every chosen species has a whole number of packages from 1 to 1,000 and a total gross weight greater than 0. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022, -p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

On a germinal products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows the 'To do' tag while any chosen species has no number of packages, or has a total gross weight entered that is not valid, such as 0. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; c-232)
On a germinal products notification with no species chosen, the overview's Commodity details task shows the 'To do' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054)
notes: Pass 1 gave one slice: the germinal completeness rule. It is not drafted alone in the backlog: it already sits in inc-099 (the germinal products overview page), whose page it is observed on, so the combiner should keep it there with the notification-hub area's draft of the same row.

Re-distil: req-1763 now reads 'the count the page makes mandatory' and adds ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004 (packages and total gross weight stay per species). c-234 settles that count as the number of packages, a whole number from 1 to 1,000, so inc-099's three completeness criteria stand; this draft adds a positive case with a valid weight entered and swaps the provenance to the current claims.

c-232 and c-462 ruled by precedence: total gross weight and temperature are optional and hold nothing back, so the prototype's chosen-temperature condition in prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-099 is not built; that claim still backs the packages condition.
The live animals half of the rule (req-126) is already met.
